title: VP, Inventory Control & Quality Assurance
description:
Stord is The Consumer Experience Company, powering seamless checkout through delivery for today's leading brands. Stord is rapidly growing and is on track to double our revenue in the next 18 months. To meet and exceed this target, Stord is strategically scaling teams across the entire company, and seeking energetic experts to help us achieve our mission.
By combining comprehensive commerce-enablement technology with high-volume fulfillment services, Stord provides brands a platform to compete with retail giants. Stord manages over $10 billion of commerce annually through its fulfillment, warehousing, transportation, and operator-built software suite including OMS, Pre- and Post-Purchase, and WMS platforms. Stord is leveling the playing field for all brands to deliver the best consumer experience at scale.
With Stord, brands can increase cart conversion, improve unit economics, and drive sustained customer loyalty. Stord’s end-to-end commerce solutions combine best-in-class omnichannel fulfillment and shipping with leading technology to ensure fast shipping, reliable delivery promises, easy access to more channels, and improved margins on every order.
Hundreds of leading DTC and B2B companies like AG1, True Classic, Native, Seed Health, quip, goodr, Sundays for Dogs, and more trust Stord to deliver industry-leading consumer experiences on every order. Stord is headquartered in Atlanta with facilities across the United States, Canada, and Europe. Stord is backed by top-tier investors including Kleiner Perkins, Franklin Templeton, Founders Fund, Strike Capital, Baillie Gifford, and Salesforce Ventures.
About the Role
Stord is looking for a Vice President of Quality to build and lead the quality function across our fulfillment network.
This leader will own the systems, standards, and operating mechanisms that ensure inventory is accurate, processes are followed, and every order moves through our network the way it was designed to. The mandate spans the full lifecycle of inventory inside our buildings from inbound receipt and putaway through picking, packing, sorting, and outbound shipment.
This is an independent quality function. While our Operations teams are responsible for delivering volume efficiently, the VP of Quality is responsible for ensuring we never achieve speed, growth, or cost improvements by compromising inventory integrity or execution quality.
This leader should be an inventory and fulfillment quality expert at heart — someone who understands how inventory moves through a complex fulfillment operation, knows where process breakdowns create downstream failures, and is relentless about identifying and eliminating root causes.
What You'll Own
Inventory Health & Accuracy
Own inventory health and accuracy across Stord's fulfillment network.
Establish the standards, controls, and operating mechanisms required to maintain book-to-floor and floor-to-book inventory integrity.
Own cycle counting, inventory reconciliation, adjustment governance, and inventory variance reduction.
Build mechanisms to identify inventory defects early and systematically eliminate their root causes.
Establish network-level metrics and reporting that make inventory health visible and actionable.
Fulfillment Process Quality
Own process adherence across inbound, receiving, putaway, picking, packing, sorting, and outbound operations.
Define the critical quality controls for each process path and ensure sites consistently execute against them.
Build audit mechanisms that identify process drift before it becomes a customer or inventory issue.
Partner with Operations, Product, Engineering, and Data to eliminate systemic sources of defects.
Develop a clear view of transaction volume, exception rates, and defect rates by process path to identify where quality is breaking down.
Lot Control & Regulatory Compliance
Own lot, expiration-date, and inventory-attribute accuracy across applicable customers and facilities.
Establish controls for FIFO, FEFO, lot traceability, recalls, quarantine, and other regulated inventory requirements.
Ensure Stord's operating processes meet applicable customer, regulatory, and contractual quality requirements.
Build a quality organization capable of supporting increasingly complex and regulated categories as Stord grows.
Continuous Improvement
Build a rigorous root-cause and corrective-action discipline across the fulfillment network.
Turn recurring defects into permanent process, system, or training improvements rather than repeatedly solving individual incidents.
Identify network-wide trends and deploy standardized improvements across sites.
Partner with Product and Engineering to ensure recurring operational defects inform the technology roadmap.
Create a culture where defects are surfaced quickly, investigated objectively, and permanently resolved.
Quality Organization
Build and lead Stord's network Quality and Inventory Control organization.
Establish clear ownership and accountability between Quality and Operations.
Develop site and regional quality leaders capable of independently auditing operational performance.
Serve as the executive escalation point when inventory integrity, regulatory compliance, or fulfillment quality is at risk.
Maintain an independent point of view and be willing to stop, challenge, or redesign processes when quality standards are not being met.
What We're Looking For
We are looking for someone who has spent their career inside large, complex fulfillment or distribution operations and understands inventory at a level most operators do not.
The ideal candidate:
Has 12+ years of experience across fulfillment quality, inventory control, operational excellence, distribution, or supply chain operations, including significant leadership experience.
Has led quality or inventory control across a multi-site fulfillment or distribution network .
Comes from a scaled 3PL, retailer, e-commerce fulfillment network, food distribution company, or similarly complex physica

score.why: VP-level role owning warehouse inventory accuracy and fulfillment process quality, not software testing. Requires multi-site 3PL/distribution operations leadership; candidate's QA automation and medical-device V&V background doesn't transfer.
score.notes: Check whether any software/QA-engineering scope exists; core ask is 12+ yrs fulfillment inventory control and multi-site ops leadership.
